remarks: Welcome to Beachcomber! Located in the heart of Cove, just minutes from the water, you can enjoy the beach lifestyle all year round. This bright and sunny 1-bedroom unit features a spacious living room, dining area, kitchen, bathroom, and a laundry room in the basement. Additional amenities include a large storage area and one reserved parking space.  Situated in a prime Cove location, Beachcomber is directly across the street from Chelsea Piers and within a short walking distance to the popular Cove Island Park and Beach. You'll also have easy access to I-95 and commuter bus lines.  Please advise all interested Buyers that the unit has a special assessment for roof replacement. Total assessment is $25k per unit or $225 per month over 15 years.
